key_idea: Thick lines are walls. Move only where there is no wall.
steps: From O you cannot go down, because of a wall. You can go right into the blue room.
From the blue room, a wall blocks A on the right. But you can go down into the purple middle room.
From the middle room, walls block E on the left and C below. You can go right into B.
